A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ExACT study. All 27 pages, including Appendices A–D, support comparison. Text and rendered-page checks establish identical scientific content, tables, figures, and equations.

before.justification: v4 reports original R-MCTS benchmark evaluations, GPT-4o learning experiments, and ablation results in Tables 2–7, with additional browser and task-instruction experiments in Appendix Tables 9–10.

after.justification: v5 retains original benchmark evaluations, learning experiments, and main-text and appendix ablations, including Tables 2–7 and 9–10.

M1.justification: The R-MCTS procedure, contrastive reflection, multi-agent debate value function, and Exploratory Learning remain identical in Section 3 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same VisualWebArena environments, WebArena GitLab tasks, and OSWorld tasks. The text-only learning experiments remain on Classifieds; no dataset, domain, or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout. This includes ReACT, ToT-BFS/DFS, Search Agent, and MCTS in Table 2, and Agent-S, AgentStore, and Learn-by-Interact in Tables 3–4.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain identical input modalities, task subsets, search and action budgets, training trajectory counts, task-instruction modifications, metrics, and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Compute-scaling experiments, difficulty breakdowns, reflection/search ablations, qualitative examples, and error analyses are unchanged. The appendix browser and task-instruction studies in Tables 9–10 are also identical.

E5.justification: Run/seed disclosure and statistical reporting are unchanged. Both versions retain point-estimate results without confidence intervals or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries, rankings, plots, and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 2 retains R-MCTS with MAD success rates of 41.0%, 28.7%, and 32.3% on Classifieds, Reddit, and Shopping, respectively. Appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations in Sections 2–3 and Appendix A are identical, including the reflection error measures, PUCT expression, and value-update equations. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about improved agent performance, transferring search knowledge through Exploratory Learning, and compute scaling.

C2.justification: The mechanism interpretations, overthinking caveat, image/web-understanding failures, and limitations concerning inference cost and long training trajectories remain unchanged in Sections 4–5 and 8 and Appendix C.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, browser modifications, Appendix D prompt templates, and the code/data access statement are identical. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 6 and the reference list are unchanged. Citation membership, novelty statements, and positioning relative to prior agent, search, and training research remain identical.

P1.justification: v5 adds the header 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025' and updates the arXiv version/date marking. Scientific prose, terminology, section ordering, and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added running header and revised first-page margin stamp are limited visual changes. Figures 1–8, Tables 1–15, captions, body layout, and pagination remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 changes only publication-status and version/date presentation. The scientific content, supporting evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information are identical, so these cosmetic updates produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
